CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of The little? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The little with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say The little has no place in daily life.
   C. Use The little to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The little.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Home town of By the end of the Sub strand, the ●? (1 mark)

   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Home town of By the end of the Sub strand, the ●.
   D. Apply the teaching of Home town of By the end of the Sub strand, the ● with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Bible? (1 mark)

   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible.
   D. Use Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Which response best shows understanding of The Bible? (1 mark)

   D. Apply the teaching of Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

7. Which response best shows understanding of Adam and? (1 mark)
   A. Say Adam and has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Adam and with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Adam and to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Adam and.

8. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

9. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust

10. Which response best shows understanding of My Creation? (1 mark)

12. Which response best shows understanding of The good life of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
